name: How do I compare guest bathroom remodel bids fairly?

mainEntity.name: How can I tell if one guest bathroom remodeling bid is better than another when prices are very different?
mainEntity.text: How can I tell if one guest bathroom remodeling bid is better than another when prices are very different?

acceptedAnswer.text: The fairest way to compare remodel bids is to line up the scope item by item. One contractor may appear cheaper because the quote excludes waterproofing, permit handling, fixture installation, or final cleanup. Another may seem more expensive because it includes a fuller scope, higher-quality materials, or contingency for hidden conditions. For guest bathrooms, the big comparison points are demolition, plumbing, electrical, waterproofing, tile labor, fixture allowances, ventilation, and finish trim. You should also ask whether the bid assumes the current layout stays the same or includes moving fixtures. If bids are too different to compare, the missing items are usually the reason. A detailed scope protects you better than a low number that grows through change orders later. In markets like Los Angeles and Pasadena, where older homes and custom finishes are common, a transparent bid is often more valuable than the cheapest one.
acceptedAnswer.description: Compare bids by scope, not just price. Check whether each quote includes demolition, waterproofing, tile setting, plumbing, electrical, fixtures, permits, cleanup, and allowances for materials. A lower bid may leave out key work, while a higher bid may include more complete protection against surprises.
